question: For 2025, list the top three order-recorded cities by Delivered-order GMV in INR. For each city, also show Delivered order count and AOV. Treat each exact city label as one city.

action.query: SELECT b.CITY, SUM(f.DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_GMV_INR, COUNT(*) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(f.DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS AOV_INR FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE b JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FINANCIALS f ON b.ORDER_ID = f.ORDER_ID JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FULFILLMENT u ON b.ORDER_ID = u.ORDER_ID WHERE b.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND b.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND b.CURRENCY = 'INR' AND u.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE GROUP BY b.CITY ORDER BY DELIVERED_ORDER_GMV_INR DESC, b.CITY ASC LIMIT 3

action.answer:
Top three exact city labels by Delivered-order GMV for orders recorded from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, restricted to INR and delivered orders. GMV is the sum of delivered sales amount; AOV is GMV divided by delivered order count.

| Rank | City | Delivered-order GMV (INR) | Delivered orders | AOV (INR/order) |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Bangalore | 233,341,258.00 | 440,743 | 529.427031 |
| 2 | Delhi | 177,702,873.00 | 339,384 | 523.604156 |
| 3 | Chennai | 155,055,243.00 | 310,963 | 498.629236 |
